कम्पनियों के नाम कम्पनी रजिस्टर से इस आधार पर नाम हटाने का आवेदन प्राप्त हुआ है कि कम्पनी के निगमन के एक वर्ष के भीतर कारोबार 


आरंभ करने में विफल रहे हैं या इस आधार पर कि कम्पनी पूर्ववर्ती 2 वित्तीय वर्षों से कारोबार नहीं कर पाई है और इस अवधि के भीतर कम्पनी 


अधिनियम, 2013 की धारा 455 के तहत निष्क्रिय कम्पनी की स्थिति प्राप्त करने का आदेश का आवेदन नहीं किया है या कम्पनी ने निष्क्रिय 
कम्पनी की स्थिति प्राप्त कर ली है, पर वे कम्पनी के रूप में पंजीकरण नहीं रखना चाहते और अतः कम्पनी रजिस्ट्रार से अपना/अपने नाम हटाने 
का अनुरोध किया है। 


3. तदनुसार, कम्पनी रजिस्ट्रार उपर्युक्त कम्पनियों के नामों को कम्पनियों के रजिस्टर से हटाने का प्रस्ताव करता है | 
4. यदि किसी व्यक्ति/संस्था को कम्पनी को कम्पनी रजिस्ट्रार से कम्पनियों का नाम हटाने के प्रस्ताव से आपत्ति है तो वह व्यक्ति/संस्था 


इस सूचना के प्रकाशन की तारीख से 30 (तीस) दिनों के भीतर उपर्युक्त कार्यालय के पते पर अपनी आपत्ति भेज सकते हैं |

following rules regulating the method of recruitment to the post of Head Constable (Riding) in the Sardar Vallabhbhai 
Patel National Police Academy, Hyderabad, under the Ministry of Home Affairs, namely:- 


l. Short title and commencement.— (l) These rules may be called the Ministry of Home Affairs, Sardar

may, by order and for reasons to be recorded in writing, relax any of the provisions of these rules with respect to any

be provided for the Scheduled Castes, the Scheduled Tribes, Other Backward Classes, ex-servicemen and other 
special categories of persons, in accordance with the orders issued by the Central Government from time to time in 
this regard.

988, except as respects things done or omitted to be done before such supersession, the President hereby makes the 
following rules regulating the method of recruitment to the post of Junior Translation Officer in the National Centre 
for Disease Control under the Directorate General of Health Service, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, 
namely:- 


l. Short title and commencement. - (!) These rules may be called the Ministry of Health and Family 
Welfare, National Centre for Disease Control, Junior Translation Officer (Group ‘B’ Post) Recruitment Rules, 2026. 


(2) They shall come into force on the date of their publication in the Official Gazette.

these rules. 


3. Method of recruitment, age-limit, qualifications, etc. - The method of recruitment, age-limit, 
qualifications and other matters relating to the said post shall be as specified in columns (5) to (/3) of the said 
Schedule. 


4. Disqualification. - No person, - 
(a) who has entered into or contracted a marriage with a person having a spouse living; or 
(b) who, having a spouse living, has entered into or contracted a marriage with any person, 
shall be eligible for appointment to the said post: 


Provided that the Central Government may, if satisfied that such marriage is permissible under the personal 
law applicable to such person and the other party to the marriage and that there are other grounds for so doing, exempt 
any person from the operation of this rule.

may, by order and for reasons to be recorded in writing and in consultation with the Union Public Service 
Commission, relax any of the provisions of these rules with respect to any class or category of persons.

कम्पनियों के नाम कम्पनी रजिस्टर से इस आधार पर नाम हटाने का आवेदन प्राप्त हुआ है कि कम्पनी के निगमन के एक वर्ष के भीतर कारोबार 
आरंभ करने में विफल रहे हैं या इस आधार पर कि कम्पनी पूर्ववर्ती 2 वित्तीय वर्षों से कारोबार नहीं कर पाई है और इस अवधि के भीतर कम्पनी 
अधिनियम, 2013 की धारा 455 के तहत निष्क्रिय कम्पनी की स्थिति प्राप्त करने का आदेश का आवेदन नहीं किया है या कम्पनी ने निष्क्रिय 
कम्पनी की स्थिति प्राप्त कर ली है, पर वे कम्पनी के रूप में पंजीकरण नहीं रखना चाहते और अतः कम्पनी रजिस्ट्रार से अपना/अपने नाम हटाने 
का अनुरोध किया है।

4. यदि किसी व्यक्ति/संस्था को कम्पनी को कम्पनी रजिस्ट्रार से कम्पनियों का नाम हटाने के प्रस्ताव से आपत्ति है तो वह व्यक्ति/संस्था

G.S.R. 34.—In exercise of the powers conferred by the proviso to article 309 of the Constitution and in 
supersession of the Income-tax Appellate Tribunal, Staff Car Driver Recruitment Rules, 984; the Income-tax 
Appellate Tribunal (Group ‘C’ Posts) Recruitment Rules, 984, in so far as they relate to the post of the Stenographer 
Grade III; the Income-tax Appellate Tribunal, Multi-Tasking Staff, Group ‘C’ Post Recruitment Rules, 205; the 
Income-tax Appellate Tribunal, Clerical Group ‘C’ Posts Recruitment Rules, 209, except as respects things done or 
omitted to be done before such supersession, the President hereby makes the following rules regulating the method of 
recruitment to the posts of Upper Division Clerk, Stenographer Grade II, Lower Division Clerk, Staff Car Driver and 
Multi-Tasking Staff, in the Income-tax Appellate Tribunal, namely :- 


l. Short title and commencement.— (l) These rules may be called the Income-tax Appellate Tribunal (Group ‘C’ 
Posts) Recruitment Rules, 2026. 


(2) They shall come into force on the date of their publication in the official Gazette. 


2. Application.- These rules shall apply to the posts as specified in column (l) of the Schedule annexed to these 
rules. 
3. Number of posts, classification and level in pay matrix.- The number of the said posts, their classification 


and level in the pay matrix attached to the said posts shall be as specified in columns (2) to (4) of the said Schedule. 


4. Method of recruitment, age-limit, qualifications, etc.- The method of recruitment, age-limit, qualifications 
and other matters relating to the said posts shall be as specified in columns (5) to (3) of the said Schedule. 


3. Disqualification.- No person,-

be provided for the Scheduled Castes, the Scheduled Tribes, the Other Backward Classes, the ex-Servicemen and 
other special categories of persons in accordance with the orders issued by the Central Government from time to time 
in this regard.

केंद्र शुरू करने से पहले 3 वर्ष की अवधि के भीतर कुछ शर्तों को पूरा करने के लिए स्वामी विवेकानंद योग अनुसंधान संस्थान (सम विश्वविद्यालय),

सूचित किया कि अनुपालन रिपोर्ट स्थायी समिति द्वारा स्वीकार कर ली गई थी। समिति की रिपोर्ट को यूजीसी के अध्यक्ष द्वारा अनुमोदित किया 
गया था। 


4. अब, इसलिए, यूजीसी अधिनियम, 1956 की धारा 3 के तहत प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, शिक्षा मंत्रालय, यूजीसी की सलाह 
पर, एतट्दारा स्वामी विवेकानंद योग अनुसंधान संस्थान (सम विश्वविद्यालय), बैंगलोर, कर्नाटक को तिरुवनंतपुरम, केरल में एक ऑफ-कैंपस केंद्र 
शुरू करने की मंजूरी देता है। 


5. स्वामी विवेकानंद योग अनुसंधान संस्थान (सम विश्वविद्यालय), बंगलौर, कर्नाटक इस मंत्रालय की पूर्व की अधिसूचनाओं में 
उल्लिखित अन्य सभी शर्तों के साथ समय-समय पर जारी यूजीसी और अन्य सांविधिक परिषदों के नियमों/विनियमों के प्रावधानों का पालन 
करेगा।

MINISTRY OF EDUCATION 
(DEPARTMENT OF HIGHER EDUCATION) 


New Delhi, the 23rd July 2026 


No. 10-3/2026-U.3(A)—Whereas, Swami Vivekananda Yoga Anusandhana Samsthana (Deemed to be University), 
Bangalore, Karnataka had uploaded its online application on UGC Portal to start an off-campus centre at Thiruvananthapuram, 
Kerala as per the UGC (Institutions deemed to be Universities) Regulations, 2023. 


2. And whereas, UGC, vide its letter No. 26-1/2026 (CPP-I/DU) dated 08.05.2026, informed that the application was 
examined by its Standing Committee, who recommended for issuance of Letter of Intent (Lol) to Swami Vivekananda Yoga 
Anusandhana Samsthana, Bangalore, Karnataka with certain conditions. Accordingly, the Ministry, on the advice of UGC, 
issued Letter of Intent (Lol) dated 01.06.2026 to Swami Vivekananda Yoga Anusandhana Samsthana (Deemed to be 
University), Bangalore, Karnataka for fulfilment of certain conditions within a period of 3 years before starting an off-campus 
centre at Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala. 


3. And further whereas, the Registrar, Swami Vivekananda Yoga Anusandhana Samsthana, Bangalore, Karnataka, 
vide letter dated 03.06.2026, submitted compliance report for fulfilment of the conditions of the Lol. The same was forwarded 
to UGC for verification and further advice. In response, UGC, vide letter No. 26-1/2026 (CPP-I/DU) dated 09.07.2026, 
informed that the compliance report was accepted by the Standing Committee. The report of the Committee was approved by 
the Chairman, UGC. 


4. Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred under Section 3 of the UGC Act, 1956, the Ministry of 
Education, on the advice of UGC, hereby accords approval to Swami Vivekananda Yoga Anusandhana Samsthana (Deemed 
to be University), Bangalore, Karnataka to start an off-campus centre at Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala. 


5. Swami Vivekananda Yoga Anusandhana Samsthana (Deemed to be University), Bangalore, Karnataka shall abide 
by all other conditions mentioned in the earlier Notification(s) of this Ministry as well as provisions of the Rules/Regulations 
of UGC and other Statutory Councils, issued from time to time.
